skills.name: casting
skills.one_line_purpose: Bind a Destiny character to a person and credit the monthly ensemble.
skills.description: Covers lead bindings, ensemble slots, and how casting is derived rather than tagged. Use when adding or changing a cast member, crediting contributors, or debugging a casting role that did not derive.

skills.name: editing
skills.one_line_purpose: Turn a plain-language outline into a rendered cut.
skills.description: Covers outline authoring, shot matching, hold caps, and rendering a cut list to video. Use when writing a story outline, debugging a beat that matched the wrong shot, or rendering a cut.

skills.name: indexing
skills.one_line_purpose: Index a source video into schema-valid, searchable segments.
skills.description: Turns a source video into schema-valid segment records via detection, keyframes, and out-of-band tagging. Use when indexing new footage, writing a Tagger, or debugging beat counts and the clean gate.

skills.name: plates
skills.one_line_purpose: Put Guardian nameplates and title cards on a rendered cut.
skills.description: Plans, renders, and burns Project Bluefin Guardian nameplates onto a cut. Use when crediting cast or contributors on screen, or changing plate copy, timing, or chrome.
